title: Yosef ben Elam of Tzippori
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Yoma 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.12b) and [Megillah 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.9b) relate that a disqualification befell the High Priest (before Yom Kippur), and Yosef ben Elam was appointed in his place. Later, when the original High Priest returned, the Sages said that Yosef ben Elam was neither High Priest nor an ordinary priest. [Horayot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.12b) gives his name as Yosef ben Ilim. In the Yerushalmi, Yoma, chapter 1, halakhah 1, he appears simply as “ben Ilam of Tzipporin.”[^1]

notes.text: The forms אלם, אילים and אילם are rendered Elam, Ilim and Ilam. Hyman’s Yerushalmi page reference is 4b.
